coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 11 ground-truth items (55%): all three prompting methods and all three tasks. The required controls and logarithmic inference-time metric are not matched.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Specifies A100 80GB SXM4 or H100 hardware instead of NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB, and generally three repetitions instead of ten per task. Fixed random seeds and the same installation of prompting frameworks and BoT repository configuration are not specified. Measures raw latency rather than base-10 logarithmic inference time per instance in seconds.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides neither the finding that BoT generally increases inference time relative to single-query methods nor the task-specific logarithmic timings. The conditional acceptance criteria within the design do not establish an actual result.
